title: Global Playbook Memory
description: Global memory of playbooks/pivots that work, consolidated automatically by /postmortem at the end of each case and reinjected by /case-intake at the start of each new case. Segmented by operation_type.

updated_by_case.description: case_id of the last case that consolidated learning into this memory.

id.description: Stable slug (kebab-case) used as the dedup key together with operation_type.

operation_type.description: Segmentation bucket. 'all' = cross-cutting pivot applicable to any pipeline.

pivot.description: Short, actionable description of the technique/pivot that worked.

when_to_use.description: Condition under which this pivot is useful.

reinforcement_count.description: How many distinct cases have confirmed this pivot. This is the expertise signal: the higher it is, the higher it ranks for reinjection.

confidence_tier.description: Derived from reinforcement_count: 1 = low, 2-3 = medium, 4+ = high.

first_seen_case.description: case_id where the pivot first appeared.

last_seen_case.description: case_id of the most recent confirmation.

source_cases.description: List of case_ids that confirmed the pivot. Used to guarantee idempotency: a case already present does not increment the count again.
